integrity: Proof based on exact two-round atomic extension patterns and all-parameter cyclic-factor conditions; two reproducible exact checking implementations are included. No external or independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite abelian 2-groups only, identity constant and ternary relational addition, quantifier rank at most two. No claim about higher quantifier ranks, arbitrary groups, or a binary-function language. Possible unindexed earlier equivalent work; no independent scientific audit.
title: Fifteen two-round theories of finite abelian 2-groups
